title: Certified, Not Explained: Exact Token Erasure in Gated Vision State Space Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.20897v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision models built on Mamba are often explained through their selective step size Delta, on the assumption that a token the scan does not admit cannot influence the prediction. We test that in a concept bottleneck model for lung-nodule malignancy built on a single gated, bidirectional selective state-space block. The answer becomes an interpretability framework: a guarantee, a procedure that checks it, and a pre-registered audit of what it explains. For a fixed gate pattern, masking the input of the causal convolution of the block and giving closed tokens zero weight at readout makes the concept and task logits exactly invariant to the closed tokens. Gating Delta is neither necessary nor sufficient. On LIDC-IDRI, a path-by-path knockout over 15 cross-validated models agrees with this in every run: the largest logit change is exactly 0 whenever the conditions hold and between 4.1 and 6.7 when they do not. The gated model reaches a pool

translated_title: 认证而非解释：门控视觉状态空间模型中的精确令牌擦除
translated_abstract: 基于 Mamba 构建的视觉模型通常通过其选择性步长 Delta 来解释，其假设是扫描未接纳的令牌无法影响预测。我们在一个基于单个门控、双向选择性状态空间块的肺结节恶性程度概念瓶颈模型中对这一假设进行了检验。答案构成一个可解释性框架：一个保证、一个检验该保证的程序，以及对它所解释内容的预注册审计。对于固定的门控模式，屏蔽该块因果卷积的输入并在读出时给被关闭的令牌赋予零权重，可使概念和任务逻辑值对被关闭的令牌完全不变。门控 Delta 既非必要条件也非充分条件。在 LIDC-IDRI 数据集上，对 15 个交叉验证模型进行的逐路径敲除实验在每次运行中都与此一致：当条件成立时，最大逻辑值变化恰好为 0；当条件不成立时，则在 4.1 到 6.7 之间。该门控模型达到了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文为门控视觉状态空间模型提出了一个可认证的可解释性框架：在固定门控模式下屏蔽因果卷积输入并给关闭令牌零权重，可在数学上保证被关闭令牌对概念和任务预测完全无影响，并在 LIDC-IDRI 肺结节实验中逐路径验证了这一保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a certified—not merely explained—interpretability framework for gated vision state-space models: with a fixed gate pattern, masking the causal convolution input and giving closed tokens zero weight exactly guarantees invariance of concept and task logits, validated by path-by-path knockouts on LIDC-IDRI.
